entities.summary: "I Wanna Go Crazy" is a song recorded by French disc jockey, David Guetta. It features guest vocals by American rapper, will.i.am from The Black Eyed Peas and was released digitally on 24 August 2009 worldwide. It also appeared on Guetta's fourth studio album, One Love.
